messages:
Maya (Acme Health): Hey team — we just got billed for a massive token spike overnight, ~1.2M tokens on invoice https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-2026-03-05-ACME. We didn't run any heavy jobs. Can someone investigate please?

Priya: Sorry to hear that, looking now. Can you share a sample request id or two from the invoice lines? Also which project/org?

Maya (Acme Health): Project acme-prod. Sample request id on invoice: req_0a1b2c3d4e5f6. The spike is between ~00:00-00:30 UTC. We have a small nightly batch but it should be ~10k tokens not 1.2M.

Priya: thanks. Pulling dashboard + ledger. @Liam can you pull ledger events for acme-prod 2026-03-05 23:50-00:40 UTC?

Liam: grabbing ledger now. I see a burst at 00:06-00:20 UTC: ~1,183,420 generated tokens billed to acme-prod. Invoice line matches ledger.

Jorge: do we have any hints in metering events? Any duplicate event_ids or high retry counts?

Priya: query against metering.events for request_id=req_0a1b2c3d4e5f6 returns 120 identical events with different ingest_ts.

OpsBot: deploy event: release/2026-03-05 failed at 2026-03-05T23:58:12Z; job batching-worker was requeued and processed 2026-03-06T00:05:09Z.

Jorge: pasting quick log snippet I pulled from the ingestion service:
```
[2026-03-06T00:05:09Z] INFO ingest: received request_id=req_0a1b2c3d4e5f6 retry_count=0
[2026-03-06T00:05:10Z] INFO ingest: processed tokens=512 prompt_tokens=120 completion_tokens=392 event_id=evt_77a3
[2026-03-06T00:05:10Z] INFO kafka: commit offset 12345 for partition 7
[2026-03-06T00:05:11Z] ERROR batching-worker: downstream timeout, retrying
[2026-03-06T00:05:12Z] INFO ingest: received request_id=req_0a1b2c3d4e5f6 retry_count=1
[2026-03-06T00:05:13Z] INFO ingest: processed tokens=512 prompt_tokens=120 completion_tokens=392 event_id=evt_77a3
```
We have duplicate processing of the same request_id/events because the consumer commit happened before all downstream acks, and the batching-worker retried, causing the same messages to be re-ingested.

Priya: so this looks like an event replay / duplication issue at midnight tied to the failed deploy + requeue. That explains the magnitude (replayed batch 100+ times for a hot partition).

Jorge: root cause summary: kafka consumer commit occurs on receipt, we only dedupe on (request_id + ingest_minute) — for long-running jobs crossing minute boundary and retries we missed true idempotency. Nightly batch was requeued and replayed across partitions, creating many duplicate metering events.

Priya: proposed immediate remediation: 1) issue provisional billing credit to acme-prod for the duplicated tokens in that window; 2) apply hotfix to ingestion dedupe to use strict request_id-only dedupe; 3) add an alert for replay_rate > 0.1% and a postmortem.

Liam: provisional credit workflow: I suggest provisional credit for 1,183,420 tokens. At our hosted rate that's $2,249. (Using current price table.) I'll create a ledger-correction CR and apply a provisional credit note referencing this thread. RevRec note draft: "Provisional credit issued 2026-03-06 for duplicate metering events caused by ingestion replay affecting acme-prod 2026-03-05 00:00-00:30 UTC. Adjustment pending engineering RCA."

Ethan: created INFRA-4521 for the dedupe hotfix and INFRA-4522 for alerting + runbook. Assigning to Jorge. Also scheduling a short postmortem for tomorrow.

Maya (Acme Health): Appreciate the fast triage. Will the provisional credit show on their dashboard/invoice immediately?

Liam: provisional credit has been applied to the ledger as of now. I pushed a corrected invoice link: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-2026-03-05-ACME?corrected=true. Card refunds typically show in 3-7 business days depending on the customer bank.

Priya: follow-up actions: Jorge will push dedupe patch to prod tonight behind a feature flag; Ethan will create a monitoring dashboard for replay_rate and an automated alert; Liam will document the revrec entry and update finance tickets. Priya to own communication to customer and close once credit shows.

Jorge: small code note for the patch: change dedupe key from `request_id + floor(ingest_ts/minute)` to `request_id` and persist seen_request_id for 48 hours. We'll also add a check to ignore any event with header `X-Replayed: true` if it came from a retry flow (defense in depth).

Priya: Maya, we'll send an email with the RCA and the provisional credit details within the hour. Can you confirm receipt when you see the updated invoice?

Maya (Acme Health): Got it — saw the corrected invoice link and the provisional credit line. Thank you everyone, this helps a lot.

Liam: logging revrec note: "Credit applied 2026-03-06: duplicate tokens due to ingestion replay — ledger adj CR-9081. Finance approver: Leah."

Ethan: patch landed to prod canary. Monitoring shows replay_rate dropped to 0.0% after canary. Scheduling full rollout in 30m. Postmortem scheduled 2026-03-07 16:00 UTC.

Priya: closing loop here. Customer notified, credit in ledger, fix rolled to prod canary, and tickets created for long-term follow-up. Reopen if anything else crops up. :white_check_mark:
